description: This file defines a function for processing data in chunks during a SHA-1 hash calculation, specifically for handling large data buffers by breaking them into manageable blocks and updating the SHA-1 context incrementally.

methods.name: int git_SHA1_Update_Chunked(platform_SHA_CTX * c,const void * data,size_t len)
methods.description: Updates the SHA-1 context with a data chunk, processing the data in blocks not exceeding SHA1_MAX_BLOCK_SIZE, and returns the total number of bytes processed.
